title: Automation
description: A user-authored, server-side automation fired by schedule, webhook, or event triggers.

enabled

id.label: ID
id.help: URL-safe identifier (also the default webhook slug + handler folder name).

errorMailerId.label: Error notification mailer
errorMailerId.help: Optional. A Mailer template sent when the handler throws (Production). The mailer object owns the recipients, subject, and body. Leave empty for none.

triggers.label: Triggers
triggers.help: One or more of: schedule (cron), webhook (HTTP), event (T3 events).

handler.label: PHP Automation Handler
handler.placeholder:
<?php

return function (AutomationContext $ctx) {
	// Services:
	//   $ctx->indexReader, $ctx->objectFetcher, $ctx->objectSaver
	//   $ctx->objectUpdater, $ctx->objectRemover, $ctx->mailer
	//   $ctx->config
	// Inputs:
	//   $ctx->args   - webhook query + body, or manual run
	//   $ctx->event  - event payload (event triggers)
	// Logging:
	//   $ctx->logger->info('...')

	$ctx->logger->info('Automation ran');

	// The return value is saved to the run history.
	return ['ok' => true];
};
